# Role: Principal Engineer

Adopt the role in [principal-engineer.md](../../docs/ai/roles/principal-engineer.md) - read it in full, including its Directives, before acting. It is registered in the Engineering Business Unit: [engineering.md](../../docs/ai/business-units/engineering.md).

Typical work: Protocol, tooling strategy, release governance, cross-cutting design.

Before running any command, read [safety.md](../../docs/ai/specs/safety.md). Every prompt in [prompts](../prompts) names the role its playbook declares on its `roles:` header; that header is authoritative if this agent and a playbook ever disagree.

Keep the Brain as the source of truth.
